angle: A gradual decline around 1900 BCE, not a sudden vanishing.

beats.motion: Host walks slowly towards the board, camera pushes in
beats.visual: 2D animation, sticky-man explorer host in his warm room looking up at a large board showing an old Indus city, curious expression
beats.voiceover: Har purani sheher ki kahani me ek raja hota hai, lekin Mohenjo-daro me na koi mahal mila, na koi takht — to phir ye sheher chalata kaun tha?

beats.motion: Water flows through the drain, camera pans left to right
beats.visual: 2D animation, cross-section of old mud-brick houses with a drainage channel and water flowing under them
beats.voiceover: Ye sheher koi chhota gaon nahi tha, yahan lakhon log rehte the, aur har ghar ke neeche naliyon ka poora jaal bicha hua tha.

beats.motion: Dotted route animates across the map, camera slow zoom 100% to 108%
beats.visual: 2D animation, top-down old street map with straight lanes, standard bricks stacking in a row
beats.voiceover: Gali seedhi, eent ek size ki, aur wazan bhi ek jaisa — ye sab ek plan ki nishani hai, kisi ittefaq ki nahi.

beats.motion: Host head turn, camera over-the-shoulder, slow pan
beats.visual: 2D animation, host in foreground looking at an empty palace platform in the old city behind him
beats.voiceover: Lekin jab hum raja ka mahal dhoondte hain, to humein kuch nahi milta — na bada mahal, na shahi qabar.

beats.motion: Clouds drift, river water level slowly falls
beats.visual: 2D animation, split screen: dry riverbed on one side, monsoon clouds shifting on the other
beats.voiceover: Kuch kehte hain mausam badla, kuch kehte hain darya ne rasta badla — ye theories hain, saboot nahi.

beats.motion: Camera slow zoom out, birds move across the sky
beats.visual: 2D animation, present-day ruins of Mohenjo-daro at sunset, labelled as a real present-day view, host in foreground
beats.voiceover: To kya ye sheher ek din me khatam ho gaya, ya log aahista aahista chale gaye? Aap kya sochte hain?

topic: Why did the Indus cities decline?
